WARNING: Simulation only; simulator uncalibrated; no physical motor was operated. Predictions are expected outcomes under matched simulated conditions, not counterfactuals of one physical run and not measurements.

c2.rule: adopt noise_aware iff (worst per-regime VALIDATION coverage >= control_recal's) AND (mean normalised interval score <= control_recal's) AND (baseline-regime trusted fraction >= control_recal's - 0.05: a predictor that abstains everywhere is not an improvement); else keep the control

c4.rule: adopt style_aware iff, on VALIDATION looseness-vs-sensor T1 cases in both the stuck and noisy-harmonics regimes, accuracy >= control - 0.02, strictly better in the noisy-harmonics regime, and confident-wrong rate <= control + 0.02

CONTINUE_MONITORING.preconditions: motor running (rpm > 50); steady or slowly varying; no mandatory-stop condition
CONTINUE_MONITORING.predicts: rpm, vib_rms, current, housing temperature at t = 30, 60, 120 s after the decision
CONTINUE_MONITORING.meaning: expected value and 90 % interval for a single future 1 s measurement if nothing is changed
CONTINUE_MONITORING.unsupported_when: operating point unfamiliar; posterior out-of-distribution; measurement noise > 3.5x the calibration level
CONTINUE_MONITORING.observed_as: fresh windows at decision time + horizon (prediction_check record, provenance SIMULATED)

REDUCE_SPEED.preconditions: motor running; target rpm > 0 and at least 5 % below the current speed; passes the Safety Supervisor
REDUCE_SPEED.meaning: expected value and 90 % interval if the commanded reduction is executed and acknowledged promptly
REDUCE_SPEED.unsupported_when: no real reduction (target >= 95 % of speed); same conditions as above
REDUCE_SPEED.observed_as: same; only counted if the command was executed (a rejected/aborted command never produces a comparison)

STOP.preconditions: motor running (rpm > 50); STOP is always permitted by the Supervisor
STOP.predicts: same four signals at 30, 60, 120 s (coast-down, cool-down)
STOP.meaning: expected value and 90 % interval if driven power is removed
STOP.unsupported_when: motor already stopped (nothing to predict); same conditions as above

T1.name: speed-step (down to 70 % for 40 s)
T1.distinguishes: imbalance vs looseness (1x vs harmonic speed exponent); looseness vs sensor fault (harmonics scale with speed only for looseness)
T1.evidence: [speed exponent of 1x vibration, speed exponent of 2x+3x harmonics, change in current per rpm]
T1.conditions: motor steady; speed only lowered; vibration limit commissioned; Safety Supervisor ALLOW/DEFER; operator approval in hardware mode
T1.abort: mandatory stop, device safety trip, command rejected/aborted/timeout/expired (communication loss), incident e-stop
T1.inconclusive: outcome unlike every learned signature (out-of-distribution), or posterior still not confident (top < 0.70 or margin < 0.30)
T1.effect: posterior is updated by the outcome likelihood; an out-of-distribution outcome is flagged and can never make a diagnosis confident

T3.name: thermal observation (hold load for up to 300 s)
T3.distinguishes: cooling failure (thermal residual keeps rising) vs electrical/mechanical overload (it does not)
T3.evidence: [slope of the thermal residual, deg C per 100 s]
T3.conditions: housing temperature below the warn limit at start; Supervisor ALLOW/DEFER
T3.abort: housing temperature at the stop limit (mandatory stop), safety trip, command failure
T3.inconclusive: out-of-distribution slope or confident posterior not reached

T4.name: coast-down (driver disabled, 40 s)
T4.distinguishes: friction/overload (short coast-down) vs cooling failure or electrical faults (normal coast-down)
T4.conditions: motor running; stopping is always permitted; result needs rpm > 150 for at least 4 s of decay
T4.abort: command failure; a latched e-stop makes the decay meaningless (inconclusive)
T4.inconclusive: decay too short to fit, or outcome out-of-distribution
